outcomes.reason: ["Missing source: the President's order of July 9, 1933 approving the Code of Fair Competition for the Cotton Textile Industry, with its numbered interpretations and conditions, is not held. This order imports \"the interpretations and conditions imposed by me on my approval of the corresponding provisions of said Cotton Textile Code\", and held Executive Order 6206-A (July 16, 1933) recites that the July 9 order contained \"condition 12 of said order providing for the termination of approval at the end of four months unless expressly renewed\". Without the July 9 text it cannot be determined whether condition 12 attached to the corresponding provisions imported here, so a possible own-terms end about four months after approval (November 1933) is unresolved.", "Executive Order 6206-A orders \"that the condition heretofore imposed as to the termination of approval of the Code is now withdrawn\" for the Cotton Textile code; no held text settles whether that withdrawal also reached this partial Rayon Weaving approval, which was made two days earlier.", "No held record shows the outcome of the Rayon Weaving hearing set for July 25, 1933, a revision under the reserved power, an express renewal, a later approval of a full Rayon Weaving code, or the placing of rayon weaving under another code before June 14, 1935. The census register, the WPA 1944 list and a held-text search for the code name show no later action, which is absence of evidence, not proof. Needed: the July 9, 1933 Cotton Textile approval order (for example in Codes of Fair Competition, vol. I) and any NRA record of the Rayon Weaving code's later disposition."]
